Marcus / Marcus's mailbox — copying Mina for ops:

Looks like the .ics export used an unspecified timezone ID (floating time) which Google sometimes interprets as UTC midnight for calendar-only imports. Two quick fixes:

1) Recreate the invite in Google/Exchange with explicit TZ IDs (Asia/Tokyo, Asia/Singapore, Australia/Sydney) so clients' calendars map correctly.
2) Or include a Google Calendar event link (not just an .ics) — that usually avoids the floating-time problem.

I can generate a corrected .ics that pins the timezone IDs and resend if you want — I did this last week for the APAC demo blitz and it fixed the next-day rollover.

— Soojin
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
